body:
First documented in #435/#965 on 2026-10-05 America/Los_Angeles; bounded Auditor follow-up recorded 2026-10-06. Original PR [#965](https://github.com/ChengshuLi/WorldAtlas/pull/965), immutable merge `f7b45a2d491ced539ca520979e182bcec9e0e90b`; parent #434. Dependency #435 is closed with released ownership. Scope: 17 exact subjects, source/semantic research only, maximum 1 PR(s), ownership only in `data/regional-review/eastern-cape-source-restoration-435/`.

## Evidence and defect

The Auditor independently verified all 17 Eastern Cape Atlas/roster identities, including seven subjects with immediate parent Cacadu and the Nelson Mandela Bay adjacent-name repeat. Existing #955 explicitly owns sibling #436's 196 exact subjects and excludes these 17. The report leaves current MDB boundary/licensing uncertainty and a cited Cacadu/Sarah Baartman rename unresolved; no bounded child owns this 17-ID restoration. The cited official reports are not retained. The Auditor did not independently replay these 17 source geometry comparisons because the 50,705,428-byte original ZAF source exceeds the 32 MiB review cap. No rename date, current legal boundary, source completeness or tier deletion is independently certified.

## Reproduction

At the immutable merge, inspect `data/regional-review/regional-review-b9aef9289b79194e/findings/subject-roster.jsonl`, `subject-assessments.jsonl`, `parent-assessments.jsonl`, `area-assessments.jsonl`, `pinned-source-reconciliation.jsonl`, `source-register.json` and `review.md`. Filter roster by area names Eastern Cape; require exactly 17 unique IDs matching the machine block. Join each location to its pinned Atlas part and hierarchy parent; compare source original IDs, role/year/license, names/tiers and preserved diagnostics. Inspect commands for side effects before executing; write new evidence only in the child path. Never overwrite the merged packet or join an oversized source.

## Success criteria and limits

Assess all 17 exact subjects and relevant parents against dated lawful official municipal roster and boundary evidence. Restore controlling MDB and Stats SA references; record reuse terms, attribution, source vintage, exact whole-file hashes and per-ID crosswalks. Resolve or explicitly preserve Cacadu/Sarah Baartman naming and Nelson Mandela Bay tier uncertainty from primary evidence. Coordinate source restoration with #955 while preserving its disjoint 196-ID machine scope. Check multipart/detached territories, islands/enclaves and original-source ancestry with repository-approved bounded verification. Preserve IDs; give engineering a bounded proposal or precise source/authority blocker. Never replace geometry based on a similarity threshold.

Preserve all 17 IDs, originals, dates, earlier factual claims and input pins. No shared hierarchy/footprint/source catalogue/release changes or production imports. A proposal is not geography approval, publication or import permission. If lawful primary evidence is unavailable within applicable limits, record the precise restoration/authority blocker.

## Baseline pin mapping

- `administrative-sources.json` → `data/administrative-sources.json`; 661416 bytes; SHA-256 `ed0051d2956271c72f8917e7da0c6f53e5dfb595bee5920cac489a65a747d633` at baseline `4877ef4e99528615daf657a376b7605d1657f817` (identical at merge).
- `geography_part-28.json` → `data/geography/part-28.json`; 6613963 bytes; SHA-256 `2aab2f36aeeb651ee8e6cc656e9541ad14e2ced2ea8160e8700ad4dc950c379d` at baseline `4877ef4e99528615daf657a376b7605d1657f817` (identical at merge).
- `hierarchy.json` → `data/hierarchy.json`; 10164089 bytes; SHA-256 `568301690ef231a85856666b57876a5efe8d8c7c6e671a56d81307b2dc28b80b` at baseline `4877ef4e99528615daf657a376b7605d1657f817` (identical at merge).
- `world-index.json` → `data/world-index.json`; 944 bytes; SHA-256 `a62d4a74f0f969e228dfcdeb2797bb689ce9836c2498cadd31ed622ad2c38c03` at baseline `4877ef4e99528615daf657a376b7605d1657f817` (identical at merge).
- `source_register_435` → `data/regional-review/regional-review-b9aef9289b79194e/findings/source-register.json`; 18354 bytes; SHA-256 `f35089b4369f02119abe0973683c507643e7a3fe37b6a82706b7cb6e480e78cb` at merge `f7b45a2d491ced539ca520979e182bcec9e0e90b`.

Readiness: bounded source research; dependency #435 closed/released; no duplicate bounded issue or overlapping child path found in complete 1135-issue open/closed pagination, and zero currently open PRs. Missing primary evidence is the research objective, not permission to replace shared geography.
